title: An Explicit Skew-Hadamard Matrix of Order 1252 via Cyclotomic Unions
summary: We construct a skew-Hadamard matrix of order 1252 = 2(5^4 + 1) using a bordered skew-Hadamard difference family over GF(5^4), with blocks given as unions of cyclotomic classes of order N = 16. This order has been reported as missing in some widely used open-source computational tables; we provide an explicit instance together with verification artifacts.
